Schedule a Partnership Meeting

Book a 30-minute intro over Zoom.

Tell us about your line, pick a time that works, and it's booked instantly — you and our partnerships team get a calendar invite and Zoom link, and we'll come ready to talk territory.

Pick a 30-minute time (Central). We'll send a Zoom invite and confirmation.

What happens when you book

  1. Your meeting is added to the HCPS partnerships calendar
  2. Outlook sends you and our team a calendar invite
  3. Zoho CRM creates your manufacturer prospect record
  4. You get a confirmation email with the Zoom link
  5. The meeting and follow-up are tracked in our CRM
